Class GoldCardSymbol

it.polimi.ingsw.model.item.card.GoldCardSymbol
public class GoldCardSymbol extends GoldCard
Class representing gold cards that give points based on the number of appearances of a specific symbol in the game.

  • Constructor Details

    • GoldCardSymbol

      public GoldCardSymbol(Symbol[] frontCorners, Symbol[] center, Map<Symbol,Integer> requirements, int points, Symbol sym, String id)
      Constructs a GoldCard with the specified front corners, center, requirements, points, and symbol.
      Parameters:
      frontCorners - The symbols representing the front corners of the card.
      center - The symbols representing the center of the card.
      requirements - A map containing how many of each symbol are required from the card.
      points - The number of points awarded by the card.
      sym - The symbol for which the card gives points.
      id - A unique identifier for a card.

    • givePoints

      public int givePoints(Card[][] board, Map<Symbol,Integer> resources, int x, int y)
      Returns the points awarded when placing the card face-up; returns 0 otherwise since cards do not have points on their back. Returns the number of points given for a symbol multiplied by the number of appearances of that symbol.
      Overrides:
      givePoints in class DrawableCard
      Parameters:
      board - The state of the game board after placing the card.
      resources - The resources of the board after placing the card.
      x - The x-coordinate of the card placement.
      y - The y-coordinate of the card placement.
      Returns:
      The points obtained by placing the card.
